svg.aria-label: Lumen screen probes: lighting PDF (normalized range)
svg.title: Lumen screen probes: lighting PDF (normalized range)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: lighting PDF (normalized range) graph 0001 | 640x672 octahedral probe atlas | R16F | valid normalized PDF 0..1 normalized PDF: 0 (black) .. p99 0.100769 (red) PDF > 1: out of normalized range (yellow) PDF < 0 (magenta) non-finite (light grey) valid zero PDF Source: LumenScreenProbeImportanceSampling.usf:190 writes PDF / max(PDFSum, 0.0001), so a valid normalized PDF lies in [0,1]. The stored payload contains 130,774 halfs >1, 48,061 <0 and 1 non-finite sample; those cannot be a normalized PDF and are categorical (yellow/magenta/grey), not silently clamped into the valid map. The 251,244 valid samples are displayed on value/p99 of the valid [0,1] range (p99 = 0.100769). The manifest records every class count. PDF units are the engine's normalized per-texel importance PDF, not radiance. This is a diagnostic of the PDF payload; the invalid classes are not used in any radiance figure.
